acceptedScope: Reviewed Swift observation source plus corrected frozen V7 host join only; 57 independent controls and 38 producer methods; initial F1/F2 closed
constraints: Preserve exact forty-file source closure, oracle/actions/protocol/transport budgets.
Compile and link both app and runner from selected source; no reuse of old app executable or old derived data.
Reuse exact approved build recipes after owned scratch path substitution; coordinate missing or changed recipe before mutation.
No simulator/device inventory, creation, boot, install, runtime, UI, screen capture, phone, listener, or explicit network in build lane.
Archive commands/tools/source/products/warnings/outputs; clean only owned scratch after process-group, holder and inode checks.
Future native originals require separate immutable selection; V7 replay anchor does not authorize future ingestion.
